meta.name: talking-head-recut
meta.description: Package an existing talking-head / interview / podcast video with timed, designed GRAPHIC OVERLAY cards — kinetic titles, lower-thirds, data callouts, quotes, side panels, picture-in-picture — synced to the transcript, on a 16:9 / 9:16 / 4:5 canvas of your choice; the clip plays untouched underneath. Trigger on "graphic overlays", "on-screen graphics", "package / dress up my video". Not plain subtitles (/embedded-captions). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给视频添加动态图文叠加层，同步字幕与画面
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为访谈或播客视频添加专业图文卡片
copy.tagline_en: Add timed graphic overlays to videos, synced with transcript
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add professional graphic cards to interview or podcast videos

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会读取你提供的现有谈话/采访/播客视频，转写内容后设计一批带时间点的图形卡片（标题、lower-thirds、数据标注、引语等），写好每张卡的HTML并合成渲染成MP4，图形叠加在原视频上，原片不动。产物在videos目录。
howto.when: 当你说出“graphic overlays”、“on-screen graphics”等关键词，或要求给视频做图形包装/装饰时触发。纯字幕需求不算，会转由其他技能处理。

say.text: 给这个采访视频加上动态标题和lower-thirds，风格偏简洁。
say.note: Claude会先转写，再设计卡片并渲染。

say.text: 把这个播客视频包装一下，加些数据标注和引语卡片。
用9:16竖版给这段谈话视频做一版图形叠加。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude transcribes your video, designs timed graphic cards (titles, lower-thirds, data callouts, quotes), writes HTML, assembles and renders to MP4 via hyperframes. Source clip untouched; output in videos/.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "graphic overlays", "on-screen graphics", or ask to package/dress up your video. Plain subtitles not covered; unclear intents route to /hyperframes.

say_en.text: Add kinetic titles and lower-thirds to this interview video, keep it clean.
say_en.note: Claude transcribes first, then designs and renders cards.

say_en.text: Package this podcast video with data callouts and quote cards.
Make a 9:16 vertical version of this talking-head video with overlays.
